name: Special Doro Wat
description: Slow-cooked tender organic chicken in rich berbere sauce with boiled egg and fresh injera.
descriptionAm: በልዩ ቅመም እና በርበሬ የተዘጋጀ ለስላሳ የዶሮ ወጥ ከእንቁላል እና ትኩስ እንጀራ ጋር የቀረበ።

name: Siga Key Wat
description: Spicy beef stew cooked in berbere, onions, and seasoned butter, served with soft injera.
descriptionAm: ጥራት ባለው የበሬ ሥጋ፣ በርበሬ እና ቅቤ የተዘጋጀ ጣፋጭ ቀይ ወጥ።

name: Shiro Tegabino
description: Clay-pot bubbling chickpea stew prepared with house-blend spices, garlic, and hot green chili.
descriptionAm: በትኩስ የሸክላ ድስት የሚፈላ የሚጣፍጥ የሽሮ ተጋቢኖ ከቃሪያ እና እንጀራ ጋር።

name: Shiro Bozena
description: Thick roasted chickpea flour stew enriched with minced tender beef and spiced butter.
descriptionAm: በስሱ በተከተፈ የበሬ ሥጋ እና የሀበሻ ቅቤ የተዘጋጀ ልዩ የሽሮ ቦዘና ወጥ።

name: Yetsom Beyaynetu (Special)
description: Grand fasting platter featuring Misir Wat, Kik Alicha, Shiro, Gomen, Atakilt, and Beetroot.
descriptionAm: የተለያዩ የጾም ወጦች ስብስብ፡ ምስር፣ ክክ፣ ጎመን፣ አታክልት እና ቀይ ስር ከእንጀራ ጋር።

name: Special Kitfo (Lebleb / Tire)
description: Minced lean beef seasoned with mitmita and pure niter kibbeh, served with ayib and gomen kitfo.
descriptionAm: ለስላሳ ቀይ ሥጋ በሚጥሚጣ እና በቅቤ የተዘጋጀ ከትኩስ አይብ እና ጎመን ክትፎ ጋር።

name: Shekla Tibs
description: Pan-seared tender beef cubes sautéed with onions, rosemary, and jalapeno over a charcoal burner.
descriptionAm: በሸክላ ድስት የሚንጣጣ የበሬ ጥብስ በሽንኩርት፣ ሮዝመሪ እና ቃሪያ ተዘጋጅቶ የቀረበ።

name: Quanta Firfir
description: Shredded soft injera simmered in spicy berbere sauce infused with sun-cured seasoned dried beef.
descriptionAm: በጣፋጭ ቋንጣ ሥጋ፣ በርበሬ እና ቅቤ የተዘጋጀ ልዩ የፍርፍር ቁርስ/ምሳ።

name: Chechebsa with Honey & Butter
description: Torn pan-fried flatbread spiced with berbere and niter kibbeh, generously drizzled with pure honey.
descriptionAm: በቅቤ እና በርበሬ የተለወሰ ቂጣ ከንፁህ የተፈጥሮ ማር ጋር የቀረበ የባህል ቁርስ።

name: Lake Tana Asa Tibs (Fried Fish)
description: Crispy seasoned whole tilapia filet served with spicy awaze, lime wedges, and salad.
descriptionAm: ጥሩ ተደርጎ የተጠበሰ የጣና ዓሣ ከሎሚ፣ አዋዜ እና ሰላጣ ጋር የቀረበ።

name: Addis Special Beef Pizza
description: Stone-baked thin crust pizza topped with seasoned ground beef, mozzarella, bell peppers, and olives.
descriptionAm: በጣፋጭ የበሬ ሥጋ፣ ሞዛሬላ ቺዝ፣ ቃሪያ እና ወይራ የተዘጋጀ ትኩስ የድንጋይ ዳቦ ፒዛ።

name: Creamy Chicken Alfredo Pasta
description: Al dente penne pasta tossed in rich garlic parmesan cream sauce with grilled chicken breast.
descriptionAm: በነጭ ሽንኩርትና ቺዝ ክሬም የተዘጋጀ ጣፋጭ የዶሮ ፔኔ ፓስታ።

name: Addis Double Cheeseburger
description: Two 100% prime beef patties, double melted cheddar, caramelized onions, pickles, and house sauce.
descriptionAm: ሁለት የበሬ ፓቲ፣ የቀለጠ ቸዳር ቺዝ፣ በካራሜል የተጠበሰ ሽንኩርት እና ድንች ጥብስ።

name: Crispy Broasted Chicken (4 Pcs)
description: Golden fried crunchy chicken pieces served with seasoned french fries, garlic mayo, and coleslaw.
descriptionAm: በወርቃማ ቀለም የተጠበሰ ጥርት ያለ ዶሮ ከቺፕስ እና ነጭ ሽንኩርት ሶስ ጋር።

name: Fresh Juice Spris
description: Layered thick organic fresh juice featuring Avocado, Mango, Papaya, and Strawberry with lime.
descriptionAm: በተፈጥሮ ፍራፍሬዎች የተዘጋጀ ባለቀለም እስፕሪስ (አቮካዶ፣ ማንጎ፣ ፓፓያ፣ እንጆሪ)።

name: Traditional Jebena Coffee
description: Freshly roasted Habesha highland coffee brewed in a traditional clay jebena with rue (Tena’adam).
descriptionAm: በጀበና የተፈላ ትኩስ የሀበሻ ቡና ከጤና አዳም እና ፋንድሻ ጋር የቀረበ።

name: Honey Pistachio Baklava (3 Pcs)
description: Flaky filo pastry layers filled with chopped pistachios and walnuts, sweetened with wild honey.
descriptionAm: በማርና በለውዝ የተዘጋጀ ጣፋጭ እና ለስላሳ የባክላቫ ኬክ።
